gloss_en: How can I convert an IFC file to COBie using IfcOpenShell or another Python solution?
title_original: How to convert an IFC file to COBie using IfcOpenShell (or other python-based solution)?
question_paraphrase: is it possible to convert ifc to cobie with python? later clarifies: wants to apply an MVD like COBie to get a smaller IFC, spreadsheet optional
phrasing_notes: friendly, informal, conflates COBie spreadsheet with COBie MVD subset
answer_summary: Use IfcCOBie/ifcfm utility (UI in BlenderBIM); COBie spreadsheet is a simplified view of IFC, mappings are ambiguous; MVD culling is rarely needed because a superset IFC is fine; FM Handover MVD draft intended to supersede COBie.

gloss_en: Can IFC hold FM data (room areas, doors, windows, extinguishers) without a full 3D model?
title_original: IFC and input data for facility management
question_paraphrase: asks politely, uncertain, whether IFC can carry room areas, doors, windows and fire extinguishers for FM without geometry
phrasing_notes: hedged, polite, lists concrete asset examples
answer_summary: Yes: build a geometry-free IFC with empty objects in BlenderBIM; coordinates still useful (COBie wants basic bounding boxes); IfcCSV can bulk edit; COBie tool checks compliance. A follow-up user found CAFM-produced IFCXML failed to open (fixed later).

gloss_en: Bonsai COBie export lacks Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue and PickLists tabs compared with other tools.
title_original: COBie export - missing Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue, PickLists tabs
question_paraphrase: compared COBie from BIM Vision and Bonsai: 5 of 20 sheets missing; other apps let you choose UK Uniclass 2015 or US OmniClass template
phrasing_notes: precise sheet names, compares tools, asks for UK/US template choice
answer_summary: Maintainers added Coordinate tab and later Systems; work continued into 2026 (unit conversion of coordinate points). Issue still open.

gloss_en: Which simple standalone tool converts IFC into a COBie spreadsheet?
title_original: IFC to COBie
question_paraphrase: asks for a simple standalone utility; remembers BIMserver and Bentley AECOsim from years ago, asks if newer options exist
answer_summary: Xbim has a DPoWValidation/COBie export built for NBS Digital BIM Toolkit; XbimXplorer has a COBie export plugin; a command line tool would be easy to make.

gloss_en: Curtain wall panels (IfcPlate) and mullions (IfcMember) do not appear in the COBie Type and Component sheets, only in Document.
title_original: Exporting COBie for Curtain Walls
question_paraphrase: thesis on COBie delivery for a curtain wall company; edited ignore XML files without effect; items show in Document sheet only
phrasing_notes: student, thesis context, describes what was tried
answer_summary: FM Handover MVD excludes IfcPlate/IfcMember; ignore files are obsolete; release 1.1.4 allows editing export config and removing IfcCurtainWall lines; COBie Toolkit also usable standalone.

gloss_en: Pset_Warranty.PointOfContact changed type in IFC4 and no longer maps to COBie 2.4 contacts; what should it contain?
title_original: Pset_Warranty PointOfContact data type changed is incompatible with COBie and needs updating
question_paraphrase: IFC2x3 used a reference to IfcOrganization that COBie 2.4 mapping relied on; IFC4 unclear whether email, name, id or actor
phrasing_notes: terse spec-level, notes COBie is contractually required but few raise issues
answer_summary: Discussion of deprecating IfcPropertyReferenceValue, using IfcActor and IfcRelAssignsToActor (as in AOH-BEM and IfcFM). Open.

gloss_en: Add more IDS facets (classification, property, partOf, entity by IFC type) for COBie model validation.
title_original: Review COBie Facet support
question_paraphrase: experimental COBie support only does Attribute and EntityType facets; cross-sheet checks not possible; proposes Classification->Category, Properties->Attributes, PartOf->containment/systems
answer_summary: No replies; open.

gloss_en: How to keep IFC organized for asset management and query assets across hundreds of project models?
title_original: Using IFC models for asset management
question_paraphrase: US state DOT with 500+ projects/year wants system-wide asset query (e.g., bridges with certain bearings and their age) from as-built IFC
phrasing_notes: long, professional, scale numbers, asks for tool names
answer_summary: Replies: file-based will not scale; use database/GIS with IFC psets mapped to tables; IfcSQL stalled; start with simple Excel/CSV for field staff; CDE, COBie, Maximo, ArcGIS options; TPF-5(480) pooled fund.

gloss_en: COBie export fails with a Python traceback in cobie24.py (IsDefinedBy).

question_paraphrase: pastes traceback only, asks 'Any idea what is happening here?'
answer_summary: Bug fixed in a maintainer commit the same day.

gloss_en: COBie Systems tab is empty although Bonsai shows 214 systems.
title_original: Cobie export - systems tab empty
question_paraphrase: exported COBie 2.4 from Bonsai FM tab; Systems sheet empty; IFC private so not shared
answer_summary: COBie needs foreign keys: systems link to components, components need a type. The model had no types so output was correct.

answer_summary: Fixed via commits including configurable list concatenation in IfcFM.

gloss_en: IDS says Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation lacks ModelLabel/ModelReference although the Revit model has them.
title_original: ModelLabel and ModelReference under Pset_Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation not reporting correctly
question_paraphrase: IDS requires ModelLabel and ModelReference; check warns property set missing; sample attached; calls it a bug
answer_summary: Duplicate property sets with the same name on an object are invalid; run ifcopenshell.validate first; IfcPatch recipe or report to Autodesk revit-ifc.

answer_summary: Use ifcopenshell.util.element.get_psets or IfcCSV with Pset name qualifier or regex wildcard; issue was query syntax.
